title: Kusanagi Nene — Profile Story

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What...? It's my turn already...?
Seriously, I'm not very good at these things...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I guess I should practice since we're probably gonna be introducing ourselves more from now on...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm Nene Kusanagi from Wonderlands×Showtime. M-My...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My dream is to become a world-class musical actress.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
H-Hey...
Don't heckle me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Great, now I forgot what I was gonna say.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, as for why I want to become a musical actress...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The rendition of “The Little Mermaid” I saw when I was in elementary school is the reason.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The Little Mermaid I saw was so dazzling. I was so moved by her performance that I decided I also want to do what she does. In junior high, I joined a children's theatre group...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I made a huge mistake while performing for that group, which made me want to quit...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But everyone in Wonderlands×Showtime reminded me how much fun it is to perform on stage. And now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel like I can sing anywhere on any stage.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I like singing...
No, I love singing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
More than anyone else, I feel...
I want that to be true, so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know we're gonna be faced with a lot of obstacles in the future, but I'm going to sing my heart out wherever we are.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I want to make everyone around the world smile...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: ...i-is about all I have to say. How'd I do...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Really...?
You got my message loud and clear? Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad I spent the time coming up with a few different variations and practicing them...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... Nothing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But still... It was nice to look back on how far I've come.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, let's all keep doing the best we can.
